name: Detective College - Episode 1: Predation
source:
"One simple rule I ended up breaking by pure impulsivity…"

Norman is a student in the Hermetic University; specifically from the Detectives Course, which has a peculiar rule:
Do not expose the existence or the curriculum to outside students.

Unfortunately, Norman ended up breaking this rule during a conversation with a troubled young man from the Economics Course.

[From [url=https://ikiru997.itch.io/detective-college]Itch.io[/url]]
